import html from typing import List # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for author, title, body and tags USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a user's forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The author's name. title : str The post's title. body : str The main content of the post. post_tags : List[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string suitable for rendering in a browser. Raises ------ ValueError If any required argument is missing or empty. """ if not all([author, title, body]): raise ValueError("Author, title, and body must be provided") # Escape user-provided content to prevent HTML injection escaped_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) escaped_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # Preserve line breaks; no need to escape quotes in body # Convert tags list into a series of elements escaped_tags = [] for tag in post_tags or []: if not isinstance(tag, str): continue # Skip non-string tags escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) escaped_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML string return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=escaped_title, author=escaped_author, body=escaped_body.replace("\n", "
"), # Preserve line breaks in the body tags=tags_html, )
